scope: Accepted 700 and frozen original flood55. No candidate implementation reviewed; not approval, coverage credit, or cadence audit.
determination: Existing transformRasterMask components traversal and existing selectRaster phase orchestration are the smallest coherent owners. Add the explicit label-zero seed interpretation and one erosion phase without new functions/types. The revised refusal of background-policy minimum/reject combinations is smaller and better grounded than implementing aggregate background criteria.
revised_proposal_received: BackgroundSeed label-zero requires explicit Seeds, refuses nonzero MinimumSize and nonnil Reject including explicit empty. Foreground-only defaults unchanged. Mixed seed union uses immutable component input. Rect is the domain; source flood uses source crop for both Rect and SampleRect.

conditions.risk: Computing background from filtered result converts rejected/unseeded foreground into label zero. Starting a background BFS wrongly limits it to one connected area.
conditions.minimal_direction: Validate every seed first; latch whether any seed addresses false in the immutable input; keep existing foreground BFS; after it add only original false pixels if latched. No background labels, counts, veto scan, or second BFS. Empty explicit seeds select none. Original all-false input with background seed selects the full Rect.
conditions.witness: disconnected-label-zero selects both disconnected strips (20 pixels); immutable-label-zero-composition excludes a discarded foreground pixel that complement-of-result incorrectly includes.

conditions.risk: Generic background minimum/veto semantics expand the API beyond the source duty; len-only rejection checks lose explicit empty presence.
conditions.minimal_direction: Adopt the revised narrow refusal: label-zero requires Seeds != nil, MinimumSize == 0, Reject == nil. Validate this in the constructor before predicate allocation and in the raw transform. Reject unknown policy values and any nonempty policy on non-components kinds. Use nil checks for Reject, not len. Keep ordinary foreground minimum/veto semantics unchanged. Explain that presence changes seed interpretation even when every supplied seed happens to be foreground.

conditions.risk: Seed lookup before hole filling, erosion before component selection, erosion per component, or changed crop exterior produces different masks.
conditions.minimal_direction: Keep source order: strict integer luminance threshold, four-connected hole filling, four-connected label lookup, selected union, four-neighbor erosion within crop, then embedding. Add Erode after the shared component/minimum phase and before Grow/Clip. Erode 0 skips; negative invokes existing convergent kernel. Background refers to input of component phase after earlier topology, not raw pixels. Rect includes zero padding outside SampleRect; document this and project actual flood with Rect=SampleRect=source crop. Do not change original/current image lifecycle.
conditions.witness: seed-evaluated-after-fill selects 25 pixels including dark center; union-before-erode yields 9 versus 0 when eroded separately; erode0 gives25, erode1 gives9, erode-1 gives0.

conditions.risk: An erosion pass can be omitted from the existing authoritative work charge, or new keys can bypass strict raw validation.
conditions.minimal_direction: Charge the new full-Rect bounded erosion pass before allocations, even when another morphology phase is present; account for the one label-zero addition scan within a justified component allowance. Keep one formula in selectRaster. No work proportional to numeric iteration magnitude or seed count times full area. Add erode and background_seed to the existing scoped canonical closed grammar and refuse null/case aliases/duplicates through the same inline/shared path. Validation must run even for empty mask/empty seeds. Preserve existing limits and absence output parity.

conditions.risk: A provider-specific flood handler or another label/fill engine would duplicate existing numeric contracts; pushing label interpretation into resource loading or permission stages would split ownership.
conditions.minimal_direction: The component owner already has membership, immutable input and seed validation; extend it. selectRaster already owns fixed mask phases; extend it with erosion. composeCells retains original image selection and three permission stages. authorTexture remains resource/grammar owner. renderRuns disc/EDT and reconstruction donor writes are unrelated and should not own flood. Use named backgroundSelected boolean and separate guard clauses, not coupled mode expressions.

conditions.risk: Six source calls are only three literal records across two textures, and synthetic whole-mask parity does not migrate real artwork or finish the raster family.
conditions.minimal_direction: Reuse stable purpose facts without six independent copied policies. Fixed binary masks cannot replace this image-dependent threshold/label pipeline across originals. Verify all 12 exact actual masks and all 56 existing global stage fields without omitting flood, plus old font/current reconstruction whole outputs. Mixed seeds are typed composition tests, not historical multi-seed flood parity. Continue holding unimplemented external-art/provider/family requirements.
